logline: Animated 3D blocky-character stories from a snowy little town where every story starts with a rule. Break the rule, find out why it exists. 3-5 parts per story; the comments decide what the character does next.

format.story_shape: Part 1 states the town rule + why someone ignores it + the moment it goes wrong + choice. Middle parts escalate based on votes. Final part reveals what the rule was protecting people from, then 'In this town...' teases the next rule.
format.narration_style: Storyteller, eerie but punchy. Opens with 'In this town...'. Short sentences. One keyword per sentence in *asterisks*.
format.visual_rules: Original blocky characters only. Never use the Roblox name, logo, fonts or assets in videos or captions. Hashtags can describe the style (#blocky #animation #story).

voices._note: Narrator: am_echo + am_puck. Neighbor: deep and old. Never add echo/reverb to voices.

voting_rules.how: Each comment = one vote for the first option it names (keyword/label/letter). Most-liked comment breaks ties. Announce the result in the first line of the next part.
voting_rules.cameos: Commenters asking to appear become townspeople (blocky avatar colors derived from their handle) with their handle on a sign or mailbox. Same safety rules as the other channels.

scene_types.shot: {cam:[x,y,z], cam_to, look:[x,y,z], look_to, fov}. Street runs along x at z=0; north houses at z=-17 (porches ~z=-12); south houses at z=17; lamps at z=-7.5 every 16 units from x=4; sign at (6,0,-7.5). Use {follow: {id, offset:[dx,y,dz], look_offset:[dx,y,dz]}} for tracking shots: portrait frames are narrow, so a moving character drifts out of a fixed shot fast. Keep cameras out of houses: north houses occupy z -21..-13, south houses z 13..21 (x = 8+16n +-5.5). Safe camera band: z between -12 and 12.
scene_types.actors: {id: {pos:[x,0,z], to:[x,0,z], face: deg (0 = facing +z/camera south, 90 = +x), walk: bool, pose: phone|scared|point|wave, expression: neutral|smile|worried|shocked|angry|suspicious, look: head turn deg}}
scene_types.lamps_on_at: seconds into scene when lamps snap on

safety_rules: Eerie, not gory. No real people/places. Kid-safe scares.
story_backlog: THE STREETLIGHTS: be home before the lights come on.
THE MAILBOX: never open mail addressed to someone who lived here before you.
THE SNOWMAN: if a snowman appears in your yard overnight, don't knock it down.
THE BELL: when the church bell rings 13 times, don't look out the window.
THE NEW KID: if someone you don't remember says they've always lived here, agree with them.
brand: assets/brand/inthistown/ (avatar.png, banner.png); names, handles and bios in assets/brand/BRAND_KIT.md
